title: Exquisite Chinese Teque Os Spring Rolls
description: A fresh and springy Cantonese dish featuring pre-fried teque os, perfect for a pescatarian-friendly meal. This show-off dish is sure to impress your guests.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the pre-fried teque os to the skillet and stir to combine with the shrimp.
Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce, scallions, sesame oil, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 2 minutes.
Serve the teque os spring rolls hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
Prepare the spring roll wrappers according to the package instructions.
Fill the spring roll wrappers with the teque os mixture and serve immediately.
